title: Halo: Combat Evolved (halo-ce-anbernic-rg35xx)
description: Halo: Combat Evolved running natively on the Anbernic RG35XX H (RG35XXH) and other Allwinner H700 handhelds with Knulli. ARM64 port of the halo-ce-universal decompilation for the Mali-G31: 60 fps menus, about 40–55 fps campaign. No emulation. Ready-to-install release; bring your own Xbox disc.
